builds.name: Help, Pix! ceiling
builds.summary: One ally E shield is 230+.5 AP before heal/shield power; Dawncore/AP/regen package favors a large single shield. Staff buff is prestacked via prior ally cast.
builds.goal: One ally E shield is 230+.5 AP before heal/shield power; Dawncore/AP/regen package favors a large single shield. Staff buff is prestacked via prior ally cast.
builds.hypothesis:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for [6] seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.5) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage and granting True Sight of them for [4] seconds.
Deathcap supplies multiplicative AP; Dawncore converts the support items base mana regen into AP/heal power; Redemption/Mikael/Ardent/Staff supply heal power, with actives excluded. Aery/Revitalize favor eligible protection; Gathering Storm fixed to 30min raises AP; Manaflow is only useful on mana users.

Shield one ally once after Staff buff; exclude Aery and item chain shields from main E number. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Dawncore, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing, Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Healing is capped by missing HP; self Visage does not amplify another ally heal.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Pix: three counted attack volleys
builds.summary: Investigate high Pix bolts from three qualifying attacks output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Pix bolts from three qualifying attacks output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each qualifying attack releases three Pix bolts. Each bolt uses a level-scaled 5 to 39 base plus 0.05 AP magic; level-18 one-volley nominal total is 117 + 0.15 AP and three volleys nominally give 351 + 0.45 AP if all nine bolts reach the scored victim. Intervening units can intercept bolts.
